name: Sumigaki Itori
source:
"I've come so far, so you'll keep loving me, right? ♡"
Sumigaki Itori

The only daughter of the Sumigaki clan. A happy-go-lucky gal, she yearns to live in the big city. She strives to be loved, and is always playing the character of the beloved child. More so than anything else, she loves all her friends dearly, and wishes to always be by them, no matter the occasion.
Flower: Black Carnations. 
Bloom Factor: [???]
Magic: [Chirutsubaki] Blossoms for the one to whom she has surrendered her heart.
[Translated from [url=https://mahoumura.com/]Official Site[/url]]
